sources.note: Couples KV-cache compression and generation-length control under a single process-reward signal, compressing harder at high-reward reasoning steps and stopping early when confidence is high.
sources.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning

sources.note: Defines certaindex, an algorithm-agnostic measure of how much a reasoning algorithm's answer has stopped changing, and builds it into a serving system that reallocates or terminates compute per query — saving up to 50% of tokens in batch inference and tripling online throughput.
sources.title: Efficiently Scaling LLM Reasoning with Certaindex

sources.note: Shows that CoT entropy follows a two-phase structure — a high-entropy exploration region that shifts abruptly into a low-entropy convergence region — and detects that shift online with the CUSUM change-point algorithm to drive early exit and trajectory-weighted voting.
sources.title: Unveiling the Entropy Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

sources.note: Detects the points where a reasoning model switches thought chains, interrupts to induce a trial answer, and stops generation when that answer's confidence is high enough — cutting chain-of-thought length substantially while raising accuracy, with no training.
sources.title: Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models

sources.note: Measures each CoT step's causal contribution by truncating the trace and forcing an answer, finds reasoning crosses a sharp single-step 'commitment boundary' after which the answer probability stops moving, and trains activation probes to detect that boundary and exit early.
sources.title: Beyond the Commitment Boundary: Probing Epiphenomenal Chain-of-Thought in Large Reasoning Models

sources.note: Recasts when-to-stop-reasoning as optimal stopping rather than classification, and proves that a fixed threshold on the probability of being correct can be arbitrarily far from optimal even when that probability is known exactly, because the decision needs the value of continuing and not the value of stopping.
sources.title: OS-Pruner: Pruning Chains-of-Thought of Reasoning Models via Optimal Stopping

result.definition: Stopping generation before the model would stop on its own, and across 6 sources a family whose reported savings are real and whose accuracy claims need care. The measured trade: one method averages 63.06 percent accuracy at 11.1 percent token reduction across three models and three benchmarks, against 59.78 and 58.70 for two competitors -- and the same source reports that early exit does not beat unrestricted generation on accuracy, with vanilla at 45.02, 74.32 and 73.69 against its 44.44, 73.3 and 71.45. So the honest framing is a savings method with a small accuracy cost rather than a free improvement. The comparison that establishes a stopping rule is doing work is against fixed truncation at matched savings: one probe recovers 89 percent of full-trace accuracy while saving 39 percent of tokens where fixed-percentage truncation at the same savings loses 23 accuracy points. The archive's related caution is that a stopping signal built on the model's own confidence inherits its calibration, and on hard problems uniformly high confidence indicates a failure to branch rather than a settled answer.
